stem: Which statement best represents the equation of the line shown on the grid and its relationship to the x-axis?

options.label: A
options.text: The equation of the line is \( x = 2.5 \), and the line is parallel to the x-axis.

options.label: B
options.text: The equation of the line is \( x = 2.5 \), and the line is perpendicular to the x-axis.

options.label: C
options.text: The equation of the line is \( y = 2.5 \), and the line is parallel to the x-axis.

options.label: D
options.text: The equation of the line is \( y = 2.5 \), and the line is perpendicular to the x-axis.

visual_elements: grid with x and y axes, horizontal line at y=2.5
